title: Mānava Śrauta-Sūtra (containing Mānava Śulba Sūtra), Bibliotheca Indica
shelf_note: Knauer's 1900 St Petersburg edition of the Mānava Śrautasūtra; this page is the end of his German preface.
structure_note: 92 records, 89 translated; 3 backsteps and 2 repeats among 66 printed numbers are consistent with roman/arabic preface pagination restarting, not a splice.

other.note: The stored <summary> describes content not on this page: 'details the manuscript sources and commentaries… preference for older manuscripts over those influenced by the rival Āpastamba school, and defends his work against the criticisms of scholar Willem Caland'. This page contains only acknowledgements (Weber, v. Schröder, Marie von Bradke, Baroda, libraries, the St Petersburg Academy).

book_verdict: Clean German transcription and a faithful English translation of the preface's acknowledgements; only the page summary drifts to content from earlier preface pages.

title: Graha Kaumudi
shelf_note: Short Devanagari karaṇa manual of planetary constants.
structure_note: 5 records; the one backstep is likely a misread folio numeral.

ocr_errors.ocr: ज्येष्ठो ण श षट् ८ र्यु सु तै र्प दिट्ट
ocr_errors.problem: numerals and bhūta-saṅkhyā words — the actual constants of the page — misread throughout lines 9–13; most lines are syllable soup

tr_errors.english: | Mars | Calculated through the "Veda" (4) and "Agni" (3) factors | … | Venus | Associated with the "Shashi" (1) and "Vidhu" (1) cycles | Saturn | … "Shriti" (5) and "Ishvo" (5)
tr_errors.problem: a table of planetary constants invented over unreadable OCR; there is no table on the leaf and the pairings are not supported by the transcription

tr_errors.english: For Mars, the value of four-thousand and fifty is used.
tr_errors.problem: a specific numerical constant with no basis in the transcription or the leaf

tr_errors.english: ensuring that the planetary masses (pinda) are correctly aligned with the observed heavens
tr_errors.problem: invented closing sentence; 'pinda' rendered as 'planetary masses'

other.note: Invented table structure presented as the page's content

pages.not_this_leaf_evidence: The English gives a planet table ('Mars | Veda (4) and Agni (3)', 'Venus | Shashi (1) and Vidhu (1)') and 'For Mars, the value of four-thousand and fifty'; the leaf is 13 lines of running verse (numbered १–५) with bhūta-saṅkhyā words, no table, and the transcription it was made from is mostly non-words.

book_verdict: The opening of the planetary-constants verses is legible on the leaf but the OCR reduces most of it to syllable soup, and the translation fills the gap with an invented table of constants; a reader would take fabricated numbers for the text.

title: Śārṅgadhara Saṃhitā (Madhya-khaṇḍa)
rights_flag: Modern digital typeset edition: running head 'MAHARISHI UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT VEDIC LITERATURE COLLECTION' with a computer Devanagari font; a recent (c. 2000s) institutional publication of a classical text — check its terms, though the Sanskrit text itself is ancient.
structure_note: 84 records, 83 with OCR/translation; printed numbers run cleanly.

tr_errors.problem: pariṇāma-śūla (pain at digestion) rendered as a modern diagnosis in the headings, while the body says 'pain during digestion'

book_verdict: Near-perfect transcription of verses 16–23 and a faithful translation, with modern disease names in the headings; the source is a modern digital typeset edition worth a rights check.

tr_errors.english: the observation of the seven planets (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn)… the true sine of declination for the seven planets
tr_errors.problem: fluent technical prose built on the misread; the procedure concerns two bodies, and the glossed list of seven planets is the model's addition

title: Dhātukathā Prakaraṇa with Commentary (PTS Pali)

structure_note: The book holds a single page record (pages_count 1): only the Google Books generic red cover. The edition's text is not here — a stub presented as a book.

other.note: The <vocab> list is repeated as a bare line of body text in the English ('Dhātu Elements, kathā pakaraṇa Discourse Treatise, commentary, Pali literature, Abhidhamma Higher Teaching')

Google Books' generated cover treated as a 'title page'; the summary asserts it 'marks the beginning of the 1892 Pali Text Society edition edited by E. R. Gooneratne', facts not on the leaf (from catalogue metadata)

book_verdict: The page itself is read correctly, but it is Google's placeholder cover and is the book's only page: a reader opening this 'book' finds no Pali text at all.

title: Vriddha Gargi Samhita
shelf_note: Garga saṃhitā on omens; this leaf covers saṅkrānti prognostics.
structure_note: pages_count field says 53 but there are 197 page records (all OCR'd and translated): the count fields are stale or a second scan was appended; worth checking.

tr_errors.problem: the conditions (Mercury, Venus or Jupiter) replaced by an invented 'bright fortnight or during the day'
